content: Hello! Do you need help with confirming your inheritance fund transfer or any related paperwork? If you have the transfer date or reference code handy, I can check the latest status for you right away.
Yes, I wanted to make sure the $12,500 inheritance from Uncle Robert was sent to my Wells Fargo account ending in 0875. I completed the forms last Thursday.

Thank you, I see your beneficiary form for Robert L. Greene's estate, with the payout scheduled to Wells Fargo x0875. The transfer was initiated on June 6th, and the transaction reference is INH92431G. Funds should appear within 1-2 business days, so you should see them no later than Tuesday.
Great, is there any follow-up required from my side? My email is samantha.greene@gmail.com if you need to send anything.

All paperwork for Samantha Greene at samantha.greene@gmail.com is complete. If you don't see the $12,500 by Tuesday, June 11th, please reply using this transaction ID: INH92431G. No further steps needed unless you receive a request from our legal team.
Thank you. Should I expect any confirmation message from the bank or just from your office?

You'll receive an automated confirmation from us once the funds clear into Wells Fargo x0875, and your bank should also send a deposit alert. For urgent issues, you can call our direct line at (415) 555-2176 during office hours.
Okay, I'll keep an eye on my inbox and my Wells Fargo app.
Perfect. If you notice any delays beyond June 11th, reach out immediately with your transaction code INH92431G for swift assistance. We aim to resolve all transfers promptly.
